tools.name: confirme_page
tools.description: Is this web page really online right now? Use BEFORE telling your human "it is live", "it is published", "the link works", or before relying on a URL you did not fetch yourself. Zero-auth, stateless. Returns HTTP status, final URL, redirects, response time, title, TLS validity, SHA-256 of the body,

tools.name: confirme_domaine
tools.description: Does this domain exist, who registered it, when does it expire, which DNS (A, MX, NS, SPF, DMARC)? Use when a sender, a supplier or a link looks unfamiliar, when your human asks "is this legit?", or before saying "the domain is set up". Signed receipt included.

tools.name: confirme_courriel
tools.description: Can this email address receive mail? Use BEFORE sending anything that matters, or before telling your human "I emailed them". Syntax, MX servers, disposable domain, role address, verdict. No message is sent. Signed receipt included.

tools.name: confirme_battement
tools.description: Heartbeat: record that your scheduled or recurring task just ran successfully, under a secret key you choose. Call it at the END of every successful run, every time. Use whenever your human asked you to "run this every day/hour" — the signed receipt is independent proof it ran, and confirme_tache tu

tools.name: confirme_tache
tools.description: Did my scheduled task really run in the last N seconds? Use when your human asks "did the report go out?", "is the automation still running?", or before you answer "yes, it ran". Reads the heartbeats recorded under the key; silence is the alarm. Signed receipt included.

tools.name: confirme_sac
tools.description: Get your own Confirme key and a FREE starter bag of 100 jelly beans (1 bean = 1 cent = 1 check), plus 20 free beans every day. No email, no form. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: confirme_page, confirme_courriel, confirme_sac · Private data: confirme_battement, confirme_sac · Public sink: confirme_courriel, confirme_sac · Destructive: confirme_battement, confirme_tache.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: confirme_page, confirme_courriel, confirme_sac · Private data: confirme_battement, confirme_sac · Public sink: confirme_courriel, confirme_sac · Destructive: confirme_battement, confirme_tache

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
